scope: Milestone three Bottosson and cached Bottosson ports for sRGB, Display-P3 and Rec.2020. Builds on the uncommitted Edge Seeker checkpoint. New targets now have 12 methods; Dualray remains P3-only. JavaScript multi-gamut ports remain milestone four.

baseline: Pre-Bottosson Edge Seeker checkpoint binary from multi-gamut-milestone-3-edge-seeker.json; source snapshot taken before this port, not the milestone-two commit.

generation.method: Five-term seed, least squares followed by 100 damped iteratively reweighted Gauss-Newton steps minimizing post-one-Halley saturation error; retain coefficients with smallest maximum training error.
generation.reference: Production matrices exported through Rust; stationary intervals and bisection for selected lower-face roots. Independent XYZ geometry is used separately in Rust tests.
generation.p3_fit: All incumbent P3 sector and seed coefficients retained. Generated primary hues only. Compile-time split hue thresholds prevent wrong sector choices at native precision.

validation.policy_reference: Independent XYZ conversion, primary-derived sector selection, channel polynomials recovered from conversion samples, analytical polynomial derivatives and one Halley step. Uses the fitted coefficients to measure the selected approximation policy, separately from geometric quality.
validation.policy_corpus: Both benchmark workloads, RGB faces and neighbours, primary hues, +/-720 degree wrapping, low/negative/zero chroma, L endpoints and powers of two approaching black/white; direct and cached, plain and checked. Bucket reference uses the actual native lane bucket. Binary64 exact-primary contacts must match either adjacent face policy within ordinary arithmetic limits.
validation.cusp_reference: Independent XYZ-derived rows, stationary-interval first-exit bisection of the selected lower face; primary hues from independent RGB primaries. 36000 offset hues plus 2880 primary-neighbour and wrapped samples; a few f64 exact contacts are excluded from unique-sector expectations.
validation.quality_reference: Independent stationary-interval geometric first exit. Measured separately from fitted mapping policy and arithmetic error; includes outer-branch differences at folded blue boundaries.
validation.quality_corpus: Grid/random, 3600 offset hues at nine lightness positions relative to cusp, plus 1001 hues by 99 lightness levels in sRGB/Rec.2020 fold windows.
validation.canonical: Each checked variant preserves accepted canonical conversion bits using authored coordinates. Plain mapping retains boundary projection, which can increase positive input chroma. Native precision-dependent precheck classifications remain separate in the CLI.

p3_compatibility.manifest: Grid + benchmark random + 32768 mixed and 32768 low-C inputs (mulberry32 0x6d756c74) + 144 endpoint/extreme-hue inputs. Every output channel serialized as native bits.
intentional_changes: Avoid L*(1-t)+t*L cancellation at tiny chroma by returning common L directly.
Resolve primary-sector rounding contacts using generated hue thresholds.
Cached checked mapping converts authored hue before quantization; accepted gray/tiny/negative chroma preserves canonical output.

worst_plain_f32_example.explanation: Plain boundary projection previously suffered cancellation in both intersection and output lightness; checked entry point preserves this in-gamut input.

assembly_audit.note: Twelve standalone wrappers: all three targets, both methods and modes. No double arithmetic/widening. Probe-only public/private visibility warnings do not occur in the production build.

benchmark.checksum: All three channels widened/accumulated per sample, consumed with black_box before timer stops. Construction, cache warmup, mode/gamut dispatch outside timing.

manifest.random: Independent stratified/jittered then shuffled H/L, C=0.4
manifest.precision: f64 originals, f32 rounded before timing

benchmark.scope: Full P3 harness in ABBA order per mode, CPU2, ASLR disabled and identical executable path. No compilation/tests/competing benchmarks during timing. Includes code layout effects and policy fixes, not a pure abstraction-cost measurement.

earlier_cached_cubic_investigation.finding: Hot timing function instructions, constants and branches identical after normalizing addresses; function placement differs. 64-byte alignment experiment gave no reliable improvement and was not adopted. Earlier +7.9% grid penalty was not stable across repeated runs.

limitations: Sampled Linux/glibc validation, not full-domain or cross-platform proof.
Approximate Bottosson boundary policy can differ meaningfully from first exit, especially at blue folds; P3 incumbent cusp-fit error remains documented.
f32 Rec.2020 near-zero encoded-channel differences are amplified by gamma; linear and perceptual limits both enforced.
Cached canonical prechecking requires authored-hue trigonometry; its extra work is intentional and timed.
P3 and new-target timings are not a balanced cross-target comparison.
Dualray and final all-13-method milestone-three comparison remain pending; JavaScript multi-gamut ports not started.
